capability_notes.compile_source: bradmin/brctl verify-lctlc | lctl-to-brir | compile-lctlc; deterministic and toolchain-independent (gcc/clang O0/O2/O3 same BRIM).
capability_notes.deterministic_replay: Deterministic HAL adapter used by bradmin run/run-signed; replay substitution for entropy/time/mailbox; bit-identical rebuilds of images/binaries.
capability_notes.device_abi: 8 device classes, capability/quota gated; 66/66 conformance PASS (also under ASan/UBSan); APDU serve loop exercised; network absent by default.
capability_notes.sign_images: bradmin keygen/sign-image/verify-image/run-signed with 32-byte raw Ed25519 host-evaluation keys (OpenSSL EVP). Admin/development path.
capability_notes.step_bound: br_vm_run(vm,budget): CLI run/run-signed/secure-run hard-code 4096 (exceed -> status=3 trap=24 exit 1); APDU EXEC takes u32 budget; unit max_steps is BRPV provenance only (not enforced at runtime by CLI); infinite loops rejected statically ('no terminal').
capability_notes.trust_chain: BRTM/1 chain enforced by production brctl (shipped .brsb runs; ad-hoc root -> trap 14 TRUST). Root private key is not in the package, so new production bundles cannot be minted here.

image_formats: BRIM/1 + BRPV/1: 80-byte header ('BRIM',4,1,1,flags{1 FACTORY,2 SIGNED,4 PROVENANCE},image_abi 1,20,16,16,32,4,hdr 80,image_version u32,requested_caps u32,ext_len 96,code_count u16,data_len u16,SHA-256(payload)[32],'Q17-BRVM-ISA41') + code(16B*n<=256) + data(<=4096) + 96-byte BRPV provenance (compiler/verifier 0x00040700, max_steps, derived caps, sha256(source), sha256(BRIR), image_version, features) [+ 64-byte Ed25519 signature]. Ceiling 51200 bytes (loader/inspector/writer); native compiler max 8368 unsigned / 8432 signed.
BRTM/1 secure bundle (.brsb): BRIM + 416-byte Root->Issuer->Release->Image trust trailer; ceiling 51616; only bundles under the compiled-in root verify (root private key not packaged).
BRCR/1 transactional control records + BRGD/1 guest persistence (state dir files <prefix>.state0/1 .image0/1 .issuer .lock .statekey); BRCT/1 128-byte signed trust controls.

notes: 5.0.0 is a qualification/release-engineering overlay; the executable contract is the frozen 4.7.0 core (units must declare version=4.7.0, image_version 9; MANIFEST.json says release 4.9.0 / version 4.7.0).
Core-61 figure inconsistency: README/PACKAGE_INFO/MANIFEST say 49,072 B; re-sealed evidence, signed release manifest, shipped object and this measurement all say 48,264 B (both <= 61,000).
The 88/96 ledger is generated by qualification/br500_acceptance.py from a hard-coded BLOCKED list; evidence/verify_br500.py independently checks evidence-log hashes/exit codes and passes here.
evidence/verify_br490.py is stale (needs evidence/br490/, not shipped) and fails; make qualification fails immediately (trust/persistence fixtures segregated into the QUALIFIED candidate).
br490-memory needs GNU /usr/bin/time (undocumented; missing here) so br500-local exits 2 after every br480/core61/brim51 step passed.
bradmin update ... --state prints FAIL/exit 1 although the update is staged and recoverable (serve EXEC then yields R2=42).
Unit max_steps is BRPV provenance only; CLI runtime budget is hard-coded 4096 (trap 24 beyond); unconditional infinite loops are rejected at compile time.
requested_caps must EQUAL derived caps (over- and under-request both rejected) -- a fabric template must compute caps from the opcodes used.
Native compiler max image is 8,368 B (8,432 signed) vs 51,200-byte loader ceiling; 512-char line limit caps a DATA row at ~240 bytes.

New production BRTM/1 bundles cannot be minted (root private key not packaged); the practical fabric path is bradmin sign-image/run-signed with a per-node Ed25519 key, exactly what the PA-LCTL adapter does.
Only R2's low 64 bits are printed by the CLI; wider readback needs the APDU serve path (STATE <=512 B per call from any 131,072-byte register).
Sources are minified (35,170-char line in brvm.c; identifiers N46/Z37/K0); GCC disables column tracking; include/brvm_compat_names.h maps names.
'ISA 4.1' here is the 32-opcode set with 16-byte instructions/ABI 1.0/LCTLC 1.1 -- not binary compatible with Large.zip's BR/1.1 (AUDIT_ERRATA F9).
Bit-identical reproducibility on GCC 13.3/OpenSSL 3.0.13: brctl, brverify, core objects and all deploy artifacts match shipped release/bin and manifest hashes; gcc/clang O0/O2/O3 emit identical BRIM.
This session is a same-toolchain, single-machine, non-independent rebuild and therefore lifts none of the 8 self-reported external blockers.
